items.label: FADU IR presentation: KIND 18749 (06-15-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Q1 2026 (unaudited, per the deck): revenue KRW 59,538 million

set.signal: Q1 2026 (unaudited, per the deck): revenue KRW 59,538 million, up 149.4% QoQ and 209.8% YoY; operating profit KRW 7,686 million vs a KRW 29,494 million loss in Q4 2025 (turn to profitability); the deck's financial-position chart notes KRW 24 Bil. of advance payments received in Q4 2025

items.reason: The KRW 24 Bil. advance payments are a footnote on the Financial Position (cash balance) slide, not part of Q4 2025 results; the old wording implied they were included in Q4 results.
items.evidence: Financial Position ... Cash Balance Debt ... *4Q'25 Advance Payments (KRW 24 Bil.)

items.label: Intekplus Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Order backlog at 06-30-2026 of KRW 126,169 million for 136 systems

set.signal: Order backlog at 06-30-2026 of KRW 126,169 million for 136 systems (orders 2024-2026, delivery 2025-2027), of which semiconductor visual inspection KRW 103,950 million (96 units) and display/battery inspection KRW 22,219 million (40 units); customer advances (contract liabilities) KRW 18,378,727 thousand vs KRW 13,731,192 thousand at end-2025; inventory KRW 43,681,800 thousand vs KRW 23,630,938 thousand at end-2025

items.reason: The report does not tie the inventory rise to systems being built; removed the unsupported causal clause and gave the stated prior-period figure instead.
